subject: Fix for [CVE-2026-21863] Remote DoS with malformed Valkey Cluster bus message
reason: The fix hardens the cluster-bus binary parser (clusterIsValidPacket for PING/PONG/MEET) against malformed packets whose gossip count or EXT_DATA extension length exceeds the packet's totlen, causing an out-of-bounds read (CVE-2026-21863). The new rejection branches are reached only by delivering crafted raw bytes to a node's cluster-bus port (base_port+10000), exactly as the added packet.tcl does with a hand-built clusterMsg.
